scene: a close view of the round pressure gauge on a white wall-mounted boiler, the red needle now standing in the middle of the green band, a grey braided filling loop hanging below with its lever turned across, dust on the pipe, hard phone flash on white enamel
a seeded loaf with its end torn off, lying on a scratched wooden board on a cafe window ledge, crumbs and a folded paper bag beside it, a cold grey street and a wet pavement blurred beyond the glass

a corner table by a dark restaurant window, two empty wine glasses, a small candle in a glass jar, a folded napkin and a spare fork, and beyond the glass a lit stone bridge doubled in still black water

a single blue ballpoint pen with a shallow dent near its clip, lying on a laminated hospital desk beside a clipboard of printed charts and a plastic cup of cold tea, harsh overhead strip light, everything slightly too bright
a black canal at night from the towpath, four sodium lamps and their long broken reflections lying flat on the water, a mooring ring and a bollard in the near dark, the far bank only a suggestion
an almost empty multi-storey car park deck at first light, wet tarmac with white bay lines, one small car at the far end, a low concrete wall and a pale flat sky beyond it

a cleared kitchen table under a lamp, one red pen lying diagonally, two overlapping mug rings, a single loose sheet of squared paper and an open sketchbook at the edge, warm bulb light against a dark window
a heavy enamel pan of thick green soup on a steel hob, a wooden spoon standing upright in it, a chopping board of stalks and a small pile of chopped green pushed to one side, one warm bulb overhead

an oversized floor lamp with a wide pale grey drum shade standing in the corner of a small living room, its light flat and institutional on the wall, a low bookshelf and a bare skirting board beside it, the rest of the room dark
